article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 14 Rare Artifacts Dated Across Early 1900s Acoustic Discs and Golden Age Radio Commercials
article-meta.kwd-group: Early Recordings, Bert Williams, Billy Murray, Ada Jones, Fritz Kreisler, Vintage Commercials, Jack Benny, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 13 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 13 resolves 14 foundational audio artifacts spanning the acoustic recording era (Victor and Columbia master matrices from 1901–1919 by pioneers Bert Williams, Billy Murray, Ada Jones, and violin master Fritz Kreisler) and vintage network radio advertisements from the Golden Age of broadcasting (including Jack Benny's 1940 Paramount holiday spot and sponsor integrations).

sec.title: 1. *Early Acoustic & Electric Master Discs* (1901–1919) Dated
sec.p: Catalog matrices from Victor Talking Machine Company and Columbia Phonograph master logs:
